sum: Greenland Technologies Holding Corporation designs, develops, manufactures, and sells components and products for material handling industries in the United States and internationally. The company provides transmission products, such as transmission systems and integrated powertrains primarily for electric forklift trucks; electric industrial heavy machinery, including electric wheeled front loader, electric excavator, and electric lithium forklifts; and provides charging solutions. Its products are used in manufacturing and logistic applications, such as factories, workshops, warehouses, fulfilment centers, shipyards, and seaports. The company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in East Windsor, New Jersey.
